facts.fact: Iscte and the University of Cabo Verde, co-funded by the OEI with a total budget of 72,000 US dollars, announced the 15-month ORAL project starting 15 October, to build open Cape Verdean Creole text and speech corpora, a first Creole large language model, translation and speech recognition models, and a chatbot.

systems.owner: Iscte and Universidade de Cabo Verde
